review: OCR coverage needs image preprocessing, multilingual checks, and field-level evaluation to turn extraction concepts into a measurable pipeline.
build: Prepare synthetic rotated, blurred, multilingual, and table-containing scans. Compare raw extraction with a preprocessing step and manually label the requested fields. Calculate intersection-over-union (IoU), per-class NMS, one-to-one region matches and a pixel-mask edit; deliberately break coordinate/dimension assumptions.
verify: Report exact field accuracy and review rate by document condition. Preserve page regions and show one case where preprocessing damages an otherwise correct field. Run `python3 -B labs/vision_grounding_geometry.py` and show the 1/7 IoU oracle. No real object detector, vision model or generative editor has been evaluated.
